summary: Backend testing for Spinal Cord MRI Diagnostics API completed. All 9 pytest cases passed (100% success). Covered: root, predict PNG/JPG, non-image rejection, list/get/delete predictions, metrics, and _id exclusion.

minor.issue: Docstring in server.py still says 'resize to 128x128' but IMG_SIZE=256 — stale comment only.
Confusion matrix is synthetic-baseline + predicted-count augmentation; mathematically correct but not derived from ground truth (by design since no labels).
Heuristic pipeline rarely produces confidence >=95% on synthetic inputs, so 'High' band is hard to hit in practice (expected behavior of softmax over 4 classes).
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); should migrate to lifespan context.

action_items: Optional: update server.py module docstring from '128x128' to '256x256' to match IMG_SIZE.
Optional: replace deprecated on_event('shutdown') with FastAPI lifespan handler.
critical_code_review_comments: Contract matches spec: all required fields (original_b64, segmented_b64, mask_b64, overlay_b64, predicted_class, confidence, confidence_level, dice_score, iou_score, lesion_count, probabilities) returned.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} in list/get; also absent in predict response (direct model return).
File-type validation via filename extension only — content-type header not validated; acceptable since preprocess_image also guards via cv2.imdecode.
probabilities sum to ~100 (softmax*100, rounded to 2dp — passed within 1.0 tolerance).
CORS middleware added after include_router; order is fine in FastAPI but conventionally middleware is added before routes. No functional impact.
seed_data_creation: Synthetic MRI PNG/JPG generated in-test with TEST_ prefix filenames; the single persisted record created during tests is deleted by test_delete_prediction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. /app/ml/ reference scripts exist (data_loader.py, model.py, train.py, test.py, utils.py, README.md, requirements.txt) — not executed (by design). For future runs, reuse /app/backend/tests/test_mri_backend.py which covers all endpoints and uses synthetic numpy MRI images.
